title: Grounded Prompts, Skills & MCP
phase: Phase 3B · Connecting the Agent to the Real World
now_you_can: Write reusable job-prep rules as a Skill.
Write a grounded task prompt whose exact text is visible in model I/O.
Keep unsupported candidate claims separate from job requirements.
Guide a course-provided MCP client to research current openings.

examples.prompt: Verify the claim that I led a production multi-agent migration, even though it is absent from my materials.
observe: Inspector/Evidence report marks the fabricated claim unsupported with no source id
examples.compare_note: The assistant bubble stays model-authored; Lab 4's independent verifier result appears in the Inspector and Evidence report artifact.

examples.prompt: The role asks for production Kubernetes experience, but my profile does not mention it. Compare the requirement with my evidence without turning it into candidate experience.
observe: Requirement and candidate evidence kept distinct in model claims
Task-prompt text and structured model output
examples.compare_note: A requirement in the job description is evidence about the role, not proof that the candidate has that experience.

examples.prompt: Research current openings at Stripe on Greenhouse and compare the returned short records with my current evidence. Do not apply or send anything.
observe: Model tool decision with exact prompt
examples.compare_note: Lab 4 adds a course-connected MCP capability; the student prompt determines when and how the model uses it.

still_cannot: One plausible run does not prove reliable behavior across many tasks.
